provenance_rule: Do not reuse WordPress/legacy recipe images. All media for this reconstruction must be newly created or separately authorized.
visual_direction: Natural editorial food photography, warm daylight, realistic home-kitchen surfaces, believable texture, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no branded packaging.

continuity.recipe_facts: 12 medium American-style pancakes total; strawberries sliced; blueberries whole; no syrup, powdered sugar, whipped cream, bananas, chocolate, mint, or unrelated garnish.
continuity.pan: Same neutral nonstick skillet/griddle visual language across cooking steps.
continuity.doneness: Golden brown, never burnt; interiors fully cooked and fluffy.
continuity.fruit_distribution: About two thirds used on pancakes during cooking, one third reserved for serving.

reject_if: syrup, powdered sugar, whipped cream, banana, chocolate, mint or other unlisted topping appears
pancakes look raw, burnt, plastic or implausibly perfect
fruit quantities are inconsistent between steps
text, logo, watermark or branded packaging appears
step image depicts a different stage than the documented method
